> 测试模型端点连通性 - 不落库；支持「已注册模型 id」或「完整端点配置」两种用法

## 用途

测试模型端点连通性 - 不落库；支持「已注册模型 id」或「完整端点配置」两种用法

## 请求

- 方法：`POST`
- 路径：`/api/v1/admin/llm/model/test`

## 请求示例

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "kind": "chat",
  "baseURL": "string",
  "apiKey": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "timeoutSeconds": 60,
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "maxTokens": 4096
}
```

## 入参

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 校验 | 枚举 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uint64 | - | - | - | - |
| kind | llm.ModelKind | - | max=16 | llmModelKind：chat、embedding | - |
| baseURL | string | - | max=512 | - | - |
| apiKey | string | - | - | - | - |
| model | string | - | max=128 | - | - |
| timeoutSeconds | int | - | - | - | 60 |
| temperature | float64 | - | - | - | 0.2 |
| maxTokens | int | - | - | - | 4096 |

## 出参

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 校验 | 枚举 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| success | bool | - | - | - | - |
| message | string | - | - | - | - |
